svg.title: Fit the model to your memory
svg.desc: Rough rules of thumb. Hardware (AMD Radeon GPU (discrete) (ROCm or Vulkan), Apple Silicon, CPU only) gives usable memory; 8 GB: ~7–8B at Q4; 12–16 GB: ~13–14B at Q4–Q5 (or 7–8B at Q8); 24 GB: ~30B at Q4 (or 13–14B at Q6–Q8); 48 GB+: ~30B+ at Q5–Q8 (a 70B at Q4 needs ~43–48 GB: plan for 64 GB). Q4 ~0.6 GB per 1B params; Q5–Q6 ~0.75 GB per 1B params; Q8 ~1.1 GB per 1B params. Add ~1–2 GB at ~8K context; long context moves you down a row.

path.aria-label: // decision flow · rough rules of thumb
Fit the model to your memory
Start from your usable memory, read across to a model size, then pick a quant.
Fit the whole model in VRAM. Splitting across
GPU and system RAM is much slower.
Ryzen AI APUs share system RAM with their Radeon
graphics: size models to the RAM you can spare, and
Add ~1–2 GB at ~8K context; long context moves you down a row.
